title: Replace your licences and business documents
summary: If your home or business was impacted by a declared natural disaster, you may be eligible for free replacement of lost or destroyed documents and licences.
intro: If your home or business is in a Local Government Area directly impacted by a declared natural disaster you may be eligible for a free replacement of documents destroyed or lost during the event.
who_can_apply: Your home or business must be in a Local Government Area directly impacted by a declared natural disaster.
what_you_need: If dealing with building documents, you may need the Application for a Duplicate Licence, Certificate or Permit – PDF.
For building documents, you should visit a Service NSW Centre or call 13 77 88 and explain that your document was lost in a declared natural disaster.
If your home address is different from your nominated address, you must provide your home address.

faqs.q: Am I eligible for free replacement of documents?
faqs.a: You may be eligible for a free replacement if your home or business is in a Local Government Area directly impacted by a declared natural disaster.

faqs.q: What types of documents can be replaced?
faqs.a: Services offered include replacements for vehicle and vessel registrations and licences, liquor and gaming licences, and various business documents like contractor licences and owner builder permits.

faqs.q: How do I get a replacement for a building document?
faqs.a: You can use the Application for a Duplicate Licence, Certificate or Permit – PDF, visit your nearest Service NSW Centre, or call 13 77 88. When contacting them, explain that your document was lost in a declared natural disaster and provide your home address if it is different from your nominated address.
